SELECT 
    c1.XCL_001 AS foil_id,
    c2.XCL_001 AS card_id
FROM 
    cards c1
JOIN 
    cards c2 ON c1.XCL_002 = c2.XCL_002
WHERE 
    c1.XCL_003 = 'Foil' 
    AND c2.XCL_003 != 'Foil'
ORDER BY 
    c1.XCL_001 ASC
LIMIT 3
